evals.prompt: I want a Zap that checks the price of an Amazon product every morning and emails me if it drops. The ASIN is B08N5WRWNW. Walk me through building it.
evals.expected_output: A step-by-step Zap build guide. Starts with a non-ScraperAPI trigger (Schedule by Zapier), then Get Structured Data (Amazon Product details, ASIN field), a Filter for price drop, then Gmail. Notes ScraperAPI is action-only and that output fields appear after a test run.

evals.prompt: How do I connect ScraperAPI to Zapier and use it to crawl my whole blog at https://example.com/blog and save every page somewhere?
evals.expected_output: Explains connecting the ScraperAPI account with an API key, then the two-Zap crawler callback pattern: Zap A Create Crawler Job (Start URL, Include regex ^/blog/, Max Depth or Crawl Budget, callback URL) and a separate Zap B with Webhooks by Zapier Catch Hook to receive each page. Warns results don't return to the same Zap.

evals.prompt: In Zapier, when a new row is added to my Google Sheet with a URL, I want to scrape that page and put the text back in the row. The pages are JavaScript-heavy React sites.
evals.expected_output: A build guide: Google Sheets New/Updated Row trigger, ScraperAPI Extract Data From URL with URL mapped from the row and Render JavaScript enabled, output_format markdown/text to keep the body small, then Google Sheets update-row mapping body back. Mentions credit cost of render.
